verdict.rationale: The evidence documents INPI's online UI filing flows: trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau, and geographic indications. It does not document any API that exposes those same operations. The only API-adjacent item is a probe showing the data.inpi.fr open-data portal returns 403 without an account-issued token, which points at most to gated data access and not to API parity with the UI's filing and management actions.
